brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: Japanese basketball news thumbnail, one finished wide PNG, exact 16:9 composition, target 1600x900 or larger than 1000 pixels wide.

Create one striking editorial sports illustration for バスケまとめ. Match the approved visual system observed in the conversation: deep ink black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B brush slashes, warm ivory #F5F2E8 type and hand-painted figure, a small orange basketball accent. Rough dry-brush / ink line work and restrained paper grain, clearly an illustration, never a photograph or photorealistic render. Few elements, bold condensed Japanese typography with excellent small-thumbnail legibility.

SUBJECT AND LIKENESS: Depict exactly ONE real athlete, Toshikazu Kato (加藤寿一), based on the official Rizing Zephyr Fukuoka portrait examined for this task. His verified visible features: Japanese man in his early thirties, lean tall athletic build, elongated oval face, narrow tapered chin and jaw, fairly prominent ears, short black subtly wavy hair parted close to the center with the longer top swept back and to both sides, forehead visible, dark straight eyebrows, dark almond eyes with clear eyelids, a straight defined nose and closed medium lips, clean-shaven with no beard or moustache. Preserve these recognizable features in expressive ivory-and-black ink drawing, with readable face planes rather than a black silhouette. No fictional substitute athlete. The portrait is only an appearance reference: do not paste or recreate the photograph, its pose, its uniform marks or its background.

ACTION: On the right 45 percent of the image, show Kato in a dynamic low forward drive, torso leaning diagonally toward the center-left, knees flexed, head up with a focused expression, controlling an orange basketball beside his right hip with his right hand while the other arm balances the motion. Three-quarter view, upper legs visible; natural anatomy, exactly two arms, hands and ball clearly readable. Keep face, both hands and the whole ball comfortably within the canvas. The torso and lower body can extend toward the lower-right edge. Use a simple unbranded ivory basketball jersey and shorts with black shadow planes; no logos, sponsors, numbers or name lettering. This is a generic imagined basketball movement, not a reenactment or claim about a particular real game, result, shot or performance. Do not draw an opponent or audience.

LAYOUT: Text occupies left 55 percent, clean and unobstructed. Top-left small brand and date. Very large ivory headline 試合結果, then large lime 当日のEFF below it. A restrained lime brush underline and a smaller ivory subheading underneath. The player fills the right side, with diagonal lime brush energy behind him, varied from a static upright jump-shooting composition. Ensure at least 5 percent safe margin for all text. Bottom-left footer is small but clearly legible. Do not include frames, scoreboards, charts, badges or extra decorative icons.

TEXT: Render ONLY these exact seven strings, in this reading order:
バスケまとめ
2026.11.17
試合結果
当日のEFF
リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

The last two strings form a visible footer. Make Japanese characters correct, intact and sharp. No other words or numbers anywhere, including on jersey or basketball.
FACTUAL LIMITS: This article aggregates multiple games and position-specific EFF lists. Kato was randomly selected from names in the fixed article; the picture must contain no player name, personal statistics, claim of participation, heroics or implication that Kato led the rankings. TOP3 explicitly belongs to league-by-league, position-by-position lists, not overall rankings. No team or league logos. No official photographs in the final image. No copied text, player names, scores or dates from the earlier style sample. Deliver one single complete thumbnail.
